scope: Province profile evidence for Vietnam's 34 current administrative units

indicators.aggregation: never sum; historical merged-province value is null unless the source publishes the current unit
indicators.absence_reason: No direct observation for current province, or source geography cannot be mapped without invalid index aggregation

indicators.aggregation: sum only for complete additive counts with the same definition and period
indicators.absence_reason: Source does not publish the required province/sector cross-tab

indicators.measure: province-level FDI flow or registered capital
indicators.aggregation: keep flow, cumulative stock and project count as separate indicators; never fill omitted province with zero
indicators.absence_reason: Province omitted from source table or attachment unavailable

indicators.measure: official park count, area, occupancy or tenants
indicators.aggregation: do not add ratios; counts/areas require explicit current-boundary coverage
indicators.absence_reason: No official aggregate or source period/boundary is not verifiable

indicators.aggregation: report as discovery evidence with method and retrieval time; never label as official establishments
indicators.absence_reason: No mapped entity or query coverage unavailable
